moments.title: “Everybody wants to save the Earth; nobody wants to help Mom do the dishes.” - P.J. O'Rourke This quote points to a familiar contradiction in human behavior: people are often drawn to large, heroic causes while overlooki
moments.selftext: “Everybody wants to save the Earth; nobody wants to help Mom do the dishes.” - P.J. O'Rourke This quote points to a familiar contradiction in human behavior: people are often drawn to large, heroic causes while overlooking the smaller responsibilities directly around them. Grand missions, such as saving the planet, can feel inspiring and meaningful because they are ambitious, visible, and widely praised. Yet character and compassion are often revealed through the ordinary tasks of everyday life. Washing the dishes or helping someone at home may receive little recognition, but these simple actions require genuine effort and consideration. The quote humorously suggests that changing the world begins with taking responsibility for the small things and helping those closest to us.

moments.title: “If something is wrong, fix it. But train yourself not to worry, worry fixes nothing.” - Ernest Hemingway Ernest Hemingway (1899–1961) was one of the most influential literary figures of the 20th century and was awarded
moments.selftext: “If something is wrong, fix it. But train yourself not to worry, worry fixes nothing.” - Ernest Hemingway Ernest Hemingway (1899–1961) was one of the most influential literary figures of the 20th century and was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1954. Born in Illinois, Hemingway served as an ambulance driver during World War I and later worked as a war correspondent. These experiences had a lasting influence on his writing. Celebrated for his direct yet powerful style, Hemingway produced enduring classics such as The Old Man and the Sea, A Farewell to Arms, and For Whom the Bell Tolls. His writing frequently explored themes of courage, love, conflict, perseverance, and human dignity. More than sixty years after his death, Hemingway remains a defining voice in literature. His work continues to inspire readers through its portrayal of true strength as the ability to endure hardship with honesty, resilience, and grace.

Macklemore spread anti-Zionist, and antisemitic propaganda. He also accused Israel of committing genocide in Gaza. What does any of this have to do with music ? moments.selftext: New GTA 6 map details (previews): - Once you unlock free roam after some missions, you can go anywhere on the map without barriers or restrictions - The map is an island (Leonida) and doesn’t have a panhandle - It’s 2x the size of GTA5 and 3x the playable area of RDR2 - Vice City is double the size of Los Santos - The built-up area outside Vice City is 11 times bigger than the built-up area outside Los Santos - The map is dense, with 5 counties and approximately 10 cities/towns - There are multiple islands, and underwater exploration will feature diving equipment, shipwrecks and treasures - The map in the pause menu is very detailed with satellite 3D imagery - It helps you to plan a heist, as it shows buildings, gang bases, stores…etc in 3D, the loot value and the entry and exit - When the map is zoomed out, you only see the main roads and highways, but the more you zoom in, more roads and alleys appear - Rockstar’s goal is to make as many enterable buildings (there are hundreds of interiors) - Areas on the map won’t be fully visible until you explore them (fog of war) - There are many ways to fast travel around the map using public transport such as buses, trains, taxis, RydeMe app (Uber), Metromover and you can either skip the trip or talk with passenger NPCs and have full conversations or listen to the radio - You can buy as many garages around the map but you can’t buy safe houses (Jason & Lucia’s house changes throughout the story because they’re on the run) - Mission waypoints on the map are pink, custom ones are cyan -Mount Kalaga located in the northern part is the highest point in the map - You’ll be able to see heat areas on the map (an area where you committed a crime before and police will be on the lookout for you there for some time, as they actually setup a perimeter around the crime scene) - There heat area is red and there’s an even larger area around it in lighter red -At 6 stars, the heat area becomes map-wide - Any building with a helipad on top will be enterable and you can explore its interior, go up either by stairs or using the elevator to reach the top floor without loading screens

moments.title: Hi! I’m doing a film right now, nasa lock-in taping ako and walang halos signal. I was told that I’m being dragged regarding something I commented years ago. Nung una, I didn’t really mind cos I’m more focused on the goo
moments.selftext: Hi! I’m doing a film right now, nasa lock-in taping ako and walang halos signal. I was told that I’m being dragged regarding something I commented years ago. Nung una, I didn’t really mind cos I’m more focused on the good days, plus I’m very much happy with my life right now. But I decided to speak up for the sake of my loved ones, while making sure to do so with respect for the LGBT community. I just want to make my statement clear. I replied to a comment on that account maybe around 5 years ago as a joke and simply to interact with people who were tagging me. Wala akong ibang intention behind it. Ngayon ko lang nalaman na nagpalit na pala ng account at content yung account na yun, and unfortunately, may mga taong ginagamit ngayon yung old comment ko para gawan ng ibang storya at i-drag ako. I know what I meant when I said it, and I won’t let someone twist an old interaction into something it was never meant to be. I’m sharing this simply to set the record straight. Moving forward, sana mas piliin na lang natin maging positive and kind. We may not always agree or understand each other, but I hope we can choose to be kinder instead of creating stories that can hurt someone. And to those who continue to drag me, I genuinely hope you find something else that brings you happiness and makes you smile. Nakakalungkot lang isipin na kailangan pang sirain o saktan yung ibang tao para may mapagtawanan o maging masaya. I hope you find happiness that doesn’t have to come at someone else’s expense. 🤍
